headline: Tiafoe vs Michelsen: two sets each, fifth set live on Ashe

story:
Why this one matters: three American men reached the last eight. This is the all-American quarter, and it has gone the distance.

BBC has it live on Ashe. Alex Michelsen took the first two sets 7-5, 6-3. Frances Tiafoe, the eleventh seed, took the next two 7-5, 6-3. In the fifth it is 3-4, Michelsen serving. That is the score. That is not a result.

Tiafoe beat Daniil Medvedev to get here. Michelsen is in his first Slam quarter-final. The United States has not had a men's major champion since Andy Roddick on this court in 2003. Write the fifth set. Do not write a finalist.
stakes: A semi-final against Alcaraz or Shelton. One American goes through. One goes home. Not decided.
rivalryAngle: Two Americans, one court, a drought that is 23 years old and still unsolved tonight.
